_what: Failures proven to be false positives, each with its reason; empty is the goal. A row matches a failure when every field it names (screen, width, mode, probe, selector) equals the failure's; selector may end in * to match a prefix. A row with decided is not a false positive but a look the person decided: its failures are kept as reported, in the run and its report, and never refuse a deploy; decided says what was decided.

rows.reason: The cover letters of a listing card (data-slot listing-cover-letters) are an aria-hidden, select-none watermark drawn at 25% (text-foreground/25) on the cover wash; the same name is written in full in the card title beside it, so it is decoration (WCAG 1.4.3 exempts text that is pure decoration).
